meta.description: Multi-horizon inference outputs produced by s4_infer.
meta.description_ko: s4_infer 단계에서 생성된 다중 수평선 예측 결과 요약

fields.model: Path to the trained model state_dict (.pth).
fields.input: Path to the preprocessed input numpy array (N, seq, feat).
fields.count: Number of samples included in this prediction batch.
fields.returns: Predicted returns for each sample and horizon (shape: N x H).
fields.current_close: Close price per sample used as the prediction base (length N).
fields.prices: Predicted future close prices per sample and horizon (shape: N x H).

fields_ko.input: 전처리된 입력 numpy 배열 경로 (형태: N x seq x feat)
fields_ko.returns: 샘플·수평선별 예측 수익률 (배열 크기: N x H)
fields_ko.current_close: 각 샘플의 기준 종가 배열 (길이 N)
fields_ko.prices: 각 샘플과 수평선에 대한 예측 종가 (배열 크기: N x H)
